    38  GElf_Chdr *
    39  gelf_getchdr (Elf_Scn *scn, GElf_Chdr *dest)
    40  {
    41    if (scn == NULL)
    42      return NULL;
    43
    44    if (dest == NULL)
    45      {
    46        __libelf_seterrno (ELF_E_INVALID_OPERAND);
    47        return NULL;
    48      }
    49
    50    if (scn->elf->class == ELFCLASS32)
    51      {
    52        Elf32_Chdr *chdr = elf32_getchdr (scn);
    53        if (chdr == NULL)
    54          return NULL;
    55        dest->ch_type = chdr->ch_type;
    56        dest->ch_size = chdr->ch_size;
    57        dest->ch_addralign = chdr->ch_addralign;
    58      }
    59    else
    60      {
    61        Elf64_Chdr *chdr = elf64_getchdr (scn);
    62        if (chdr == NULL)
    63          return NULL;
    64        *dest = *chdr;
    65      }
    66
    67    return dest;
    68  }

   111  ElfW2(LIBELFBITS,Chdr) *
   112  elfw2(LIBELFBITS,getchdr) (Elf_Scn *scn)
   113  {
   114    ElfW2(LIBELFBITS,Shdr) *shdr = elfw2(LIBELFBITS,getshdr) (scn);
   115    if (shdr == NULL)
   116      return NULL;
   117
   118    /* Must have SHF_COMPRESSED flag set.  Allocated or no bits sections
   119       can never be compressed.  */
   120    if ((shdr->sh_flags & SHF_ALLOC) != 0)
   121      {
   122        __libelf_seterrno (ELF_E_INVALID_SECTION_FLAGS);
   123        return NULL;
   124      }
   125
   126    if (shdr->sh_type == SHT_NULL
   127        || shdr->sh_type == SHT_NOBITS)
   128      {
   129        __libelf_seterrno (ELF_E_INVALID_SECTION_TYPE);
   130        return NULL;
   131      }
   132
   133    if ((shdr->sh_flags & SHF_COMPRESSED) == 0)
   134      {
   135        __libelf_seterrno (ELF_E_NOT_COMPRESSED);
   136        return NULL;
   137      }
   138
   139    /* This makes sure the data is in the correct format, so we don't
   140       need to swap fields. */
   141    Elf_Data *d  = elf_getdata (scn, NULL);
   142    if (d == NULL)
   143      return NULL;
   144
   145    if (d->d_size < sizeof (ElfW2(LIBELFBITS,Chdr)) || d->d_buf == NULL)
   146      {
   147        __libelf_seterrno (ELF_E_INVALID_DATA);
   148        return NULL;
   149      }
   150
   151    return (ElfW2(LIBELFBITS,Chdr) *) d->d_buf;
   152  }
